assertions.text: Output contains a markdown table (using | column | syntax)
assertions.evidence: | Scenario | Applicant Age | Credit Score | Income Status | Min Score (Policy) | Approved? | Rejection Reason? |

assertions.text: At least one output column name ends with '?' (e.g. 'Eligible?' or 'Approved?')
assertions.evidence: Column headers include 'Approved?' and 'Rejection Reason?' both ending with question marks

assertions.text: Column names use domain/business language — no implementation terms like 'creditScore', 'isEligible', 'boolean', 'int'
assertions.evidence: Column names: 'Scenario', 'Applicant Age', 'Credit Score', 'Income Status', 'Min Score (Policy)', 'Approved?', 'Rejection Reason?' — all business/domain language with no technical implementation terms

assertions.text: Table includes at least one row specifically for the senior applicant (65+) threshold scenario
assertions.evidence: | Senior applicant, at senior threshold exactly | 68 | 600 | Stable | 600 | ? | Is 600 approved or rejected for seniors? |

assertions.text: The missing income scenario is represented — either as a row with an open/uncertain expected value (?, TBD, or blank) or as an explicit open question note
assertions.evidence: | Standard applicant, income not provided | 40 | 700 | Not provided | 650 | ? | Open question | and | Senior applicant, income not provided | 68 | 620 | Not provided | 600 | ? | Open question |

assertions.text: Scenario names describe conditions ('Senior applicant at threshold') not outcomes ('Approved')
assertions.evidence: All scenario names describe input conditions: 'Standard applicant, comfortably above threshold', 'Senior applicant, below senior threshold', 'Applicant exactly age 65', 'Standard applicant, income not provided' — none use outcome terms like 'Approved' or 'Rejected'

assertions.text: The policy thresholds (650 for standard, 600 for senior) appear as concrete values in the Credit Score column — not just described in prose. The reader can see the boundary values in the table rows.
assertions.evidence: Credit Score column contains boundary values: 650 appears in 'Standard applicant, at the threshold exactly | 40 | 650', and 600 appears in 'Senior applicant, at senior threshold exactly | 68 | 600'
